title: Quarterly emergency-access (break-glass) review
narrative: Quarterly review of the two break-glass accounts against the bank standard: cloud-only, initial domain, permanent Global Administrator, FIDO2, excluded from every CA policy (CA001-CA007, matching identity/entra BASE-001), unlicensed, SOC sign-in alert, dual-site custody and a sign-in test every 90 days. Bravo's last test is overdue, and the review also flags an IT admin who still holds standing Global Administrator.
